overview_description: Email an invoice, purchase invoice, account statement or payment to the recipients you name.
intro: Communications send documents by email. This area emails one invoice, purchase invoice, account statement or payment to the recipients you name. It has 1 endpoint, and all seven SDKs call it.
warning: **Every call sends real email to the recipients you name.**
notes: **The body names one document.** Send one of `invoice`, `purchase_invoice`, `account_statement` or `payment`, holding that document's `id`.
**Recipients and content sit beside the document key.** The body also takes `to`, `cc`, `bcc`, `subject`, `body` and `template`.
**Each call sends real mail.** Use addresses you control when you try it.

endpoints.title: Email a document
endpoints.summary: Emails one invoice, purchase invoice, account statement or payment.
endpoints.description: The body names one of `invoice`, `purchase_invoice`, `account_statement` or `payment`, holding that document's `id`, beside `to`, `cc`, `bcc`, `subject`, `body` and `template`. This sends real mail to the recipients.

schema.description: Name one document to email, beside the recipients and content.

invoice.description: The `id` of the invoice to email, such as `INV-0001`. Send one of `invoice`, `purchase_invoice`, `account_statement` or `payment`.

purchase_invoice.description: The `id` of the purchase invoice to email.

account_statement.description: The `id` of the account statement to email.

payment.description: The `id` of the payment to email.
